title: A real easy way to take care of your plants when you are away
text: A real easy way to take care of your plants when you are away. This is a great way to maintain my Florida lanai plants when I am away. I travel often (either for business, visiting family or just taking a cruise). I am so glad I found these so I no longer have to ask (beg) a neighbor to come over and water the plants when I am gone. I use a slow drip on my Christmas cactus plant and a faster drip on my pathos vines, it's nice being able to control the release. Now I have to figure out if I can use these when I go for three weeks in October to visit some friends, but even if they are only good for two weeks it's an amazing aid. Easy to set up, easy to use, highly recommend!
